raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Caligula Wikipedia page and incorrectly stated that Caligula’s mother was Agrippina the Younger. The page (and historical fact) identifies his mother as Agrippina the Elder (Vipsania Agrippina). This misinterpretation would directly lead to the wrong mother-in-law for Lollia Paulina.
